text: This DEED OF SALE is made at Chennai on this 5th day of April, 2023, between John Doe (Vendor) and Jane Smith (Vendee). The Vendor hereby sells, conveys and transfers the property absolutely to the Vendee. Consideration amount Rs. 50,00,000.

ABSOLUTE SALE DEED. The Vendor is the absolute owner of the scheduled property. In consideration of the sum paid, the Vendor conveys the title to the Purchaser free from all encumbrances. Signed Witness.
This LEASE DEED is executed on 10th March 2024 by Landlord Kumar. The Lessee shall pay a monthly rent of Rs. 15,000. The lease is for 11 months. Advance amount Rs. 1,00,000.
DEED OF LEASE. This indenture witnesseth that the Lessor grants the Lessee the right to use the premises for commercial purpose. Rent is payable on 5th of every month.
RENTAL AGREEMENT entered into between Landlord Ravi and Tenant Suresh. The Tenant agrees to pay rent of Rs. 8000 per month. The house is for residential use only.
This DEED OF GIFT is made by Father to Son. Out of natural love and affection, the Donor hereby gifts the property to the Donee without any monetary consideration.
